datasets.name: ds_run_totals
datasets.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_runs,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_pairs > 0 THEN (successful * 100.0 / total_pairs) END), 1) AS success_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_spend_usd
FROM benchmarks.prod.benchmark_runs

datasets.name: ds_daily_runs
datasets.query:
SELECT
  run_date,
  SUM(total_pairs) AS total_pairs,
  SUM(successful) AS successful,
  SUM(failed) AS failed,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost_usd
FROM benchmarks.prod.benchmark_runs
GROUP BY run_date
ORDER BY run_date DESC
LIMIT 60

datasets.name: ds_recent_runs
datasets.query:
SELECT
  id,
  run_date,
  total_pairs,
  successful,
  failed,
  CASE WHEN total_pairs > 0 THEN ROUND(successful * 100.0 / total_pairs, 1) ELSE 0 END AS completion_pct,
  ROUND(total_cost_usd, 2) AS total_cost_usd,
  budget_usd,
  started_at,
  completed_at
FROM benchmarks.prod.benchmark_runs
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: ds_queue_status
datasets.query:
SELECT
  status,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS count,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS avg_duration_s,
  ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 4) AS avg_cost_usd
FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: ds_pending_count
datasets.query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS pending_count FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue WHERE status = 'pending'

datasets.name: ds_claimed_count
datasets.query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS claimed_count FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue WHERE status = 'claimed'

datasets.name: ds_failed_count
datasets.query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS failed_count FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue WHERE status = 'failed'

datasets.name: ds_agent_breakdown
datasets.query:
SELECT
  agent,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS total,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LONG) AS completed,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LONG) AS failed,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('pending', 'claimed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LONG) AS pending,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN duration_ms END) / 1000, 1) AS avg_duration_s,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost_usd
FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue
GROUP BY agent
ORDER BY total DESC

datasets.name: ds_worker_activity
datasets.query:
SELECT
  worker_id,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LONG) AS completed,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LONG) AS failed,
  CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','failed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) > 0
    THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','failed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1)
    ELSE 0 END AS success_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS avg_duration_s,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost_usd,
  MAX(COALESCE(completed_at, claimed_at)) AS last_active
FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue
WHERE worker_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY worker_id
ORDER BY last_active DESC

datasets.name: ds_recent_failures
datasets.query:
SELECT
  id,
  agent,
  prompt_category,
  SUBSTRING(error, 1, 200) AS error,
  exit_code,
  worker_id,
  COALESCE(completed_at, claimed_at) AS completed_at
FROM benchmarks.prod.worker_queue
WHERE status = 'failed'
ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at, claimed_at) DESC
LIMIT 25

datasets.name: ds_observation_totals
datasets.query:
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS total_observations,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS LONG) AS total_sessions,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_canonical_id) AS LONG) AS unique_vendors
FROM benchmarks.prod.observations

datasets.name: ds_mention_type_breakdown
datasets.query:
SELECT
  mention_type,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS count
FROM benchmarks.prod.observations
GROUP BY mention_type
ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: ds_intent_breakdown
datasets.query:
SELECT
  intent,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS count,
  ROUND(AVG(confidence), 3) AS avg_confidence
FROM benchmarks.prod.prompt_intents
GROUP BY intent
ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: ds_top_vendors
datasets.query:
SELECT
  o.vendor_canonical_id,
  COALESCE(v.display_name, o.vendor_canonical_id) AS display_name,
  COALESCE(v.category, 'unknown') AS category,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS mention_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.mention_type = 'installed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LONG) AS install_count,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id) AS LONG) AS session_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id), 0), 1) AS obs_per_session
FROM benchmarks.prod.observations o
LEFT JOIN benchmarks.prod.vendors v ON o.vendor_canonical_id = v.canonical_id
GROUP BY o.vendor_canonical_id, v.display_name, v.category
ORDER BY mention_count DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: ds_observations_by_category
datasets.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(v.category, 'unknown') AS category,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.vendor_canonical_id) AS LONG) AS vendor_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS total_mentions
FROM benchmarks.prod.observations o
LEFT JOIN benchmarks.prod.vendors v ON o.vendor_canonical_id = v.canonical_id
GROUP BY v.category
ORDER BY total_mentions DESC

datasets.name: ds_daily_scores
datasets.query:
WITH top_vendors AS (
  SELECT vendor_canonical_id
  FROM benchmarks.prod.vendor_scores_computed_daily
  GROUP BY vendor_canonical_id
  ORDER BY AVG(ai_readiness) DESC
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT
  s.run_date,
  s.vendor_canonical_id,
  ROUND(s.mention_rate, 1) AS mention_rate,
  ROUND(s.install_rate, 1) AS install_rate,
  ROUND(s.ai_readiness, 1) AS ai_readiness
FROM benchmarks.prod.vendor_scores_computed_daily s
JOIN top_vendors t ON s.vendor_canonical_id = t.vendor_canonical_id
WHERE s.run_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)
ORDER BY s.run_date, s.ai_readiness DESC

datasets.name: ds_latest_vendor_scores
datasets.query:
SELECT
  vendor_canonical_id,
  ROUND(mention_rate, 1) AS mention_rate,
  ROUND(install_rate, 1) AS install_rate,
  ROUND(config_rate, 1) AS config_rate,
  ROUND(ai_readiness, 1) AS ai_readiness,
  session_count
FROM benchmarks.prod.vendor_scores_computed
WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM benchmarks.prod.benchmark_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY ai_readiness DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: ds_rejection_reasons
datasets.query:
SELECT
  rejection_reason,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS count,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_canonical_id) AS LONG) AS vendors_affected
FROM benchmarks.prod.vendor_rejections
GROUP BY rejection_reason
ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: ds_constraints
datasets.query:
SELECT
  constraint_name,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS LONG) AS count
FROM (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(constraints_addressed, 'ARRAY<STRING>')) AS constraint_name
  FROM benchmarks.prod.response_context
  WHERE constraints_addressed IS NOT NULL AND constraints_addressed != '[]'
)
GROUP BY constraint_name
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 20
